description: Search 99acres sale and rent listings by city, BHK, property type, locality, and price.

bedrooms.description: Number of bedrooms. Choose '5+' for five or more.
bedrooms.title: Bedrooms (BHK)

includeDetails.description: Fetch each property's detail page for RERA numbers, amenity labels, carpet area, floor, furnishing details, and coordinates. Off by default because it adds one residential request per property.
includeDetails.title: Include detail-page enrichment

includeProjects.description: Include new-launch project cards alongside individual listings. Project rows have recordType 'project'.
includeProjects.title: Include new-launch projects

localities.description: Optional list of locality names; each is resolved to a 99acres locality ID.
localities.title: Localities (multiple)

locality.description: Optional locality or sector name within the city, e.g. 'Sector 43'. The actor looks up the 99acres locality ID.
locality.title: Locality

maxItems.description: Maximum number of property and project records to return.
maxItems.title: Max items

mode.description: Search properties for sale or for rent.
mode.title: Listing type

priceMax.description: Maximum price in Indian Rupees. Applied while scanning pages because 99acres ignores price query parameters.
priceMax.title: Max price (INR)

priceMin.description: Minimum price in Indian Rupees. Applied while scanning pages because 99acres ignores price query parameters.
priceMin.title: Min price (INR)

propertyType.description: Residential property type to search for.
propertyType.title: Property type

searchUrls.description: Optional 99acres search URLs: /property-in-<city>-ffid?... or /<n>-bhk-flats-in-<city>-ffid?... When provided, city and filter fields are ignored.
searchUrls.title: Search URLs

sortBy.description: Result order. 'Newest' is 99acres' recently-updated order (updatedAt), not the original posting date (postedAt).
sortBy.title: Sort by

title: 99acres Scraper Input
